_doc: Regression thresholds for scripts/perf.sh (docs/TESTING.md §3). 'default' = this machine at full speed (release build), 'air' = --air mode (efficiency cores, 8 GB policies). Each metric: max and/or min. Missing metrics are skipped. Tighten when you make something faster; never loosen to hide a regression without saying why in the commit. Baseline (M1 Pro, 2026-10): scroll p95 0.6 ms, zoom p95 2.0 ms, fit p95 1.9 ms; air: scroll 9.7, zoom 9.5, fit 154.

timeline_scroll_fit_cpu_p95_ms.note: known issue: zoomed-out timeline with 500 clips is slow on E-cores; lower to 40 when fixed
